name: Persiom -Yakusoku no Tsudou Basho-
source:
PERSIOM takes place in a dungeon that leads to Hades and hell. Even though it is extremely dangerous, heroes enter to find treasure and make lots of money. Oh, and you can also capture female monsters. 

[from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/01/april-2000-eroge-releases/]Micchi's blog[/url]]
translation:
《PERSIOM》的舞台是一座通往冥府与地狱的地下城。尽管危险至极，英雄们仍为寻找宝藏、赚取巨款而进入其中。哦，你还可以捕获女性怪物。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/01/april-2000-eroge-releases/]Micchi的博客[/url]]
